findings.label: Missing golden dataset
findings.description: enrichment_v0.jsonl not created. Cannot validate acceptance scenarios K1, K2, K3 or calibrate enrichment outputs against real data patterns. Should contain 30+ JSONL records with expected_health_score_bucket, expected_sentiment, expected_tone fields.

findings.label: Zero test coverage for S3.4, S3.7, S3.8
findings.description: Health scorer (S3.4), prompt template engine (S3.7), and learning loop (S3.8) have no unit tests. Cannot verify feature validation, rule-based fallback scoring, token budget enforcement, EWMA drift detection, or feedback ingestion logic.

findings.label: LightGBM model not trained
findings.description: account_health_lgb.pkl exists as empty artifact. Health scorer tests pass only because they never attempt to load it and fall back to rule-based scoring. Must either train a synthetic model or remove the fallback and require tests to mock model behavior.

findings.label: Template engine spec-implementation mismatch
findings.description: Spec requires Jinja2 templates with token budget enforcement, but implementation uses simple format strings. No token budget enforcement tested, no multi-part template composition, and complex tone logic not exercised. Scaling path to Jinja2 unclear.

findings.label: Acceptance scenarios incomplete
findings.description: K1, K2, K3 test behavior but do not read from golden dataset. Performance benchmarks measure synthetic latency only (mock sleep); real API latency and end-to-end graph integration not validated.
